faqs.q1: How can I rent a bike?
faqs.a1: Choose your bike, select pickup and drop dates, provide required documents, pay the deposit, and you're ready to ride!
faqs.a2: A valid driving license (original), government photo ID (Aadhaar or Passport), and a security deposit are required.
faqs.a3: Yes, a valid original two-wheeler driving licence is strictly mandatory for renting any motorbike or scooter.
faqs.a4: Yes, a refundable security deposit is collected before handover and fully refunded within 24-48 hours post-trip.
faqs.q5: Do you provide helmets with the rental?
faqs.a5: Yes, we provide one complimentary ISI/DOT certified helmet with every rental. Additional helmets are available on request.
faqs.a6: We follow a same-to-same fuel policy. Please return the motorcycle with the same fuel level as recorded at pickup.
